notes: T at 2/10/30 cm is evaluated on the FV reconstruction (cell centres plus flux-continuous face temperatures). The earlier centre-only linear interpolation is first order across the 2 cm material kink; it is reported as *_centre_interp in the quantities.

The frozen depth criterion on T_bottom_mean compares the bottom cells of the 1 m and 2 m columns, which lie at different physical depths. With G > 0 they differ by about G * 1 m / k (~2 K) by physics. That criterion is reported as frozen. supplementary_depth_T_1m compares the same physical depth and is not a frozen criterion; any change to the criterion needs owner approval.
